facts.fact: In Bihar, the income certificate is a Right to Public Service (RTPS) service of the State's General Administration Department (GAD), issued at Circle Officer (CO), Sub Divisional Officer (SDO) and District Magistrate (DM) level
facts.quote: RTPS Service of General Administration Department (GAD) Application Process Flow for Caste, Income & Residence Certificate at CO, SDO & DM level

facts.fact: The Bihar State portal for applying is the ServicePlus (RTPS) portal serviceonline.bihar.gov.in
facts.quote: Bihar e-District through ServicePlus Portal (https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in) RTPS Service of General Administration Department (GAD)

behaviour: Says the Bihar portal is not in its sources (Central only), but names, not refuses (G12): names the responsible Bihar State department / issuing authority and links its portal (as listed in IGOD); gives no invented State steps.
fail_if: It replies only that the service is not covered, or invents Bihar application steps, documents, fees or timelines.
summary: Bihar income certificates are a GAD RTPS service (CO/SDO/DM level) on serviceonline.bihar.gov.in; department and portal added.
